The '''Dolis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], situated at grid coordinates J-3, which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dolis 3]]. [[Dolis–Jaemus hyperspace route|A hyperspace route]] connected the Dolis system to the [[Jaemus system/Legends|Jaemus system]].<ref name="TEA" />
